seo.title: Multiples of 3 Grid Game - 3s Times Tables Speed Clicker
seo.metaDescription: Master multiples of 3 with this 10x10 math grid game. Fast-paced multiplication facts practice designed for school Chromebooks.
seo.intro: Multiplication fluency relies on identifying skip-counting sequences and numerical patterns across the hundreds chart. In this game, students identify every multiple of 3 from 3 up to 99. Recognizing diagonal stripe patterns on the 100 chart deepens place value comprehension and connects skip counting with the digit-sum divisibility rule for 3.
seo.howToPlay: Identify and click all multiples of 3 scattered throughout the 100-number grid. Green checks mark correct multiples. Accidental clicks on non-multiples flash red and cost 2 seconds of round time. Locate all 33 multiples before time runs out.
seo.teacherNotes: Encourage students to notice the diagonal patterns that emerge on a 10-wide chart when clicking multiples of 3. Ask them to test the sum-of-digits trick for numbers like 57 (5 + 7 = 12, which is divisible by 3).

faq.q: What is the rule for finding multiples of 3?
faq.a: A whole number is a multiple of 3 if the sum of its digits is divisible by 3. For example, with 84: 8 + 4 = 12, and 12 is divisible by 3, so 84 is a multiple of 3.

faq.q: How many multiples of 3 are between 1 and 100?
faq.a: There are 33 multiples of 3 in the range 1 to 100, starting at 3 and ending at 99 (since 100 divided by 3 equals 33 with a remainder of 1).
